_note: Required fields: id, dice, ability. Everything else has a reasonable default.
name: Dagger

_note: hands defaults to "one" if omitted — this entry is identical to omitting "hands".
name: Shortsword

_note: hands:"versatile" + versatileDice: the big die only counts if the off hand is truly EMPTY (no shield/focus). With something in the other hand, the normal "dice" is used.
name: Longsword

_note: hands:"two" truly cancels the attack (with a warning) if the player carries something in the off hand — you can't wield a two-handed weapon with a shield.
name: Greataxe

_note: classes (optional): a list of substrings compared against the "Class & Level" field of the player's sheet, case-insensitive — any class whose name CONTAINS one of these substrings can use it. Without this field, any class can use the weapon (default behavior). You can mix languages if your players use presets with different names.
name: Battleaxe

_note: customModelData (optional): a free integer, unique per weapon you want to reskin. It needs a resource pack model that reads it — see templates/resourcepack/.
name: Enchanted Rapier

_note: damageType (optional, default "physical"): any word works, but for the DM's resistances/vulnerabilities (/dndsheet damagetype) to really match, always use the exact same name. 5e types already used in the mod: physical, slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, fire, cold, lightning, acid, poison, psychic, radiant, necrotic, force, thunder.
name: Flame Tongue Sword
